eventMetadata.context_description: The dominant 99% market-implied probability for a Lucknow high of 41°C or below on June 3 stems from India Meteorological Department observations and short-range guidance showing maximum temperatures near 36–40°C, driven by a western disturbance interacting with moist easterly winds from the Bay of Bengal. Historical June maxima average near 39–40°C, but the current synoptic pattern favors continued moderation through the period. A faster dissipation of the disturbance or delayed moisture influx could allow temperatures to climb above the threshold, though model consensus currently supports the cooler outcome.
